skill.name: template-skill
skill.description: A minimal template for drafting a new AI skill with basic metadata and an instruction placeholder.
skill.summary: Start a custom AI skill from a small, reviewable scaffold.
skill.author: ArtemisAI

security_audit.summary: The skill contains only a short SKILL.md template with front matter and an instruction placeholder. Static analysis found no suspicious patterns, and semantic review found no prompt injection or malicious intent.

content.user_title: Create a Skill from a Clean Template
content.value_statement: New skill authors need a clean starting point for marketplace submissions. This template provides minimal metadata and a clear place for instructions.
actual_capabilities: Provides a minimal SKILL.md scaffold with name and description metadata.
Identifies the insertion point where authors can add operating instructions.
Supports use as a starting point for Claude, Codex, or Claude Code skill content.
Contains no scripts, dependencies, or runtime code.
Keeps the structure small for review and customization.
limitations: It does not include domain-specific instructions or workflows.
It does not provide examples, assets, or automation scripts.
It cannot perform tasks until an author adds real skill instructions.
It does not validate completed skills.

use_cases.title: Draft a New Skill
use_cases.description: Start a custom skill with a simple file structure and required metadata.

use_cases.title: Teach Skill Structure
use_cases.description: Show contributors the minimum pieces needed before adding detailed instructions.

use_cases.title: Review Empty Scaffolds
use_cases.description: Identify whether a submitted package is only a template and needs real content.

prompt_templates.title: Create Starter Instructions
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this template to draft a skill for [domain]. Add clear triggers, workflow steps, and safety boundaries.

prompt_templates.title: Customize Metadata
prompt_templates.prompt: Update the skill name, description, tags, and summary for a [task] skill. Keep the description specific and concise.

prompt_templates.title: Add Review Checklist
prompt_templates.prompt: Expand this template with authoring instructions, examples, and a review checklist for [team]. Include security and limitation notes.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare Marketplace Submission
prompt_templates.prompt: Turn this template into a complete marketplace skill for [workflow]. Include triggers, step order, output expectations, and user-facing documentation.

output_examples.input: Draft a simple documentation skill from this template.
output_examples.output: A concise skill description, trigger guidance, and ordered instructions for producing documentation.

output_examples.input: Review whether this template is ready for publication.
output_examples.output: The package is not ready because it lacks real instructions, examples, and domain-specific guidance.

output_examples.input: Prepare this scaffold for a team workflow skill.
output_examples.output: A completed outline with team-specific triggers, steps, boundaries, and review notes.

best_practices: Add clear usage triggers and step-by-step instructions.
Document what the completed skill will not do.
anti_patterns: Using broad descriptions that do not name the task.

faq.question: Is this a complete working skill?
faq.answer: No. It is a starter template that needs real instructions before publication.

faq.question: Does it run code or install dependencies?
faq.answer: No. The reviewed package contains only a short SKILL.md file.

faq.question: Can I use it with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The metadata declares support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: What should I add first?
faq.answer: Add the task-specific description, activation guidance, workflow steps, and expected outputs.

faq.question: Why is the description important?
faq.answer: The description tells the assistant when the completed skill should be used.

faq.question: Is there any security concern in the template?
faq.answer: No evidence was found of malicious instructions, code execution, network access, or prompt injection.
